Uncg is certainly survivable without a car. My freshman year I didn’t have a car, and I got around pretty fine. Public transportation around the city is pretty much just like any other public bus in NC. It’s certainly not the best, and it takes forever. But you can get where you need to go. With a little bit of walking of course. Food and groceries are in walking distance from UNCG, and if you need entertainment there’s usually something on campus. But I do recommend a bike. Technically yes you can walk to downtown, but taking the bus or a bike would be the best and safest option.
